verdict.rationale: Manufact has a REST API, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every common OpenAPI path returning 404. The llms.txt docs index and the official MCP server are separate capabilities and are not a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
